title: Deleted notes
body:
Keeps crushing while deleting parts of the current handwritten note (iPad Air 5) due to poor memory handling and infrequent synchronisation. Apple has failed to address this issue since the launch of iPadOS 16, although they acknowledged to me - after six months of testing and troubleshooting with support over the phone - that the problem exists and that it is software related.
In spite of that, I still use my iPad and this app to take notes on lectures at university, and approximately once a week it happens. Luckily it shows symptoms before crashing so one can prevent the really bad things by creating a new note and copying everything over to it, where it syncs with the cloud immediately. I find this both ridiculous and unacceptable.

title: Notes to the future
body:
Apple Notes is a useful tool, but it could benefit from further development and additional features. It would be particularly beneficial to enhance the embedding capabilities, allowing for more seamless integration of images, tables, and other editing options. This would certainly take it beyond its current basic level.

Moreover, a more sophisticated interaction with other programs, such as the calendar, would significantly improve its functionality. I also believe a more structured organization system, such as folders or tags, could enhance user navigation through notes.

In addition, the introduction of a collaborative feature would allow users to share or work on notes with others, which could be a game-changer for many. Finally, integrating a reminder or alert system within the notes could serve as a valuable tool for remembering important tasks or deadlines.

Overall, while Apple Notes is a solid program, these improvements could take it to the next level of user experience.

title: Almost perfect
body:
While the notes app itself is almost flawless I would like to see a couple feature additions / fixes 

1. Being able to turn on and off ‘auto sort ticked items’ for each note (just like it was fixed with pictures in notes so you can set them to appear small or large individually) 

2. Being able to search in text and view attachments from locked notes WHEN they are unlocked - I can’t really see why is there such an option to bring the locked notes into an unlocked state , if you cannot interact with them through search and etc. 

3. The locked notes staying unlocked or at least staying where you were at when switching apps 
Like in Photos the hidden section stays at exactly the same screen when leaving the app and opening it from recent apps - you only need to verify yourself with face or touch id and there you are you can continue from where you were 
In spite of this in Notes - when you exit the application and go back most of the times the view resets to the beginning of the note and you have to scroll all the way down if you want to continue from where you were

(4. Also there’s a bug when you reopen a note sometimes the editing toolbar is missing above the keyboard - only exiting and closing the app solves it)
